Per project rules, no rejection or adverse inference is drawn from this gap; the company stays in the database. Note also that the claimed industry ('Нефтегаз и химия' - oil/gas and chemicals) is inconsistent with the declared HS 300490 (medicaments) and with the company name, which points to a veterinary/human vaccine and biologicals manufacturer; that is a data-quality flag for the identity/HS team, not a risk finding, and per the 23.11.2026 rule HS mismatch is not a rejection ground. Recommended action: re-run this company once search connectivity is restored, checking (1) OFAC/UN/EU/UK/BIS lists by exact and near name, (2) eCourts/NCLT/High Court records, (3) CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings press releases, (4) Indian pharma/biologicals export news and any Russia/CIS registration or supply records.
